coran.intro: Reading (qāʿida), memorisation (hifẓ) and Quran player. Riwāya Ḥafṣ ʿan ʿĀṣim, exact Tanzil text.
coran.hifz_texte: Notebooks E1 (children) and N1 (adults): yearly plan, three tracks every day (new, recent, old), reviews at D+1, D+2, D+3, D+7, D+14, D+30, practice validation by a parent. The teacher remains the only judge; no ijāza.
coran.qaida_texte: Booklets qc1 to qc3: the letters and signs of the Medina Muṣḥaf, then the rules of recitation (tajwid), Ḥafṣ reading. The adult reads first, the learner repeats.
sciences.intro: Creed, fiqh (Mālikī school), life of the Prophet ﷺ, hadith and adab — the books of the Religion series.
sciences.re_texte: Levels re1 to re5: creed, sīra, prophets, fiqh, adab, supplications, hadith; practice log signed by a parent (never graded).
sciences.ra_texte: Levels ra1 to ra4, each published once frozen (the demo shows ra1 and ra2 as a preview): excerpts from Mālikī works, hadiths with their verified reference, case studies, tables, calculations.
sciences.fidelite: Everything shown comes from the books, exactly as written: the app adds no religious content.
ecriture.trace_texte: With a finger or a stylus: I trace over the dots, trace on the light letter, then write alone. The app checks the direction (right to left), the lane and the dots, and never gives a grade.
ecriture.en_attendant: The paper exercise book remains the main way to write: the app guides the movement, and the parent ticks “done in the book” in the lesson.
lectures.texte: Small graded books for each level: illustrated pages, foldable translation, “I understand”, “My words” and the “I read this book” stamp. Each booklet is offered after the lesson where the learner met its words; keep it on the device to read it without network.

gar.intro: What we promise, and how it is checked.
gar.contact: A question about these guarantees? Ask the school or the Awzid team.
gar.coran_titre: The Quran, exact to the sign
gar.coran: The Quran text comes only from the Tanzil reference text (riwāya Ḥafṣ ʿan ʿĀṣim). It is never retyped or corrected automatically.
gar.coran_preuve: Check: every verse of the books is compared byte for byte at each import; the hifẓ notebook, the reader and the tutor are tested the same way.
gar.hadiths: A hadith is quoted with its number only if it is in the register with the status “verified”. An unverified number is removed before reaching the phone.
gar.hadiths_preuve: Check: hadith register and automatic tests of the masking.
gar.ia: The tutor never writes the Quran, quotes no hadith outside the register and never gives religious rulings: it passes the question to the teacher. No free text before 13; for a child or teen, nothing without the parent's agreement.
gar.ia_preuve: Check: 1,081 “trap” tests and a fake malicious tutor, all blocked; the AI stays off until these tests are passed with the real model.
gar.voix: Recordings stay on the phone and are erased after 7 days. A family can choose to send one to the class teacher: encrypted, listened to by the teacher only, erased after a few days, deletable at any time. Never used to train an AI.
gar.voix_preuve: Check: sent only with the family's agreement (parent code for a child), encryption tested, access refused to any other account, automatic erasure; no other program reads the audio.
gar.traceurs: No advertising, no third-party advertising or analytics tracker. Fonts and content are served by Awzid.
gar.traceurs_preuve: Check: browser security policy that forbids external scripts.
gar.enfants: No streak to lose, no ranking, no virtual currency, no night notification, no faces in illustrations. The most protective settings are the defaults.
gar.enfants_preuve: Check: the parent sees the state of each protection (My account → Children's protections).
gar.recompenses: Only symbolic rewards (stamp, star, milestone): never random, never for sale, never compared.
gar.recompenses_preuve: Check: no shop or lottery in the app.
gar.paiement: Payment happens on the provider's secure page (card, mobile money, PayPal). Awzid never sees your card. The free trial asks for no payment method.
gar.paiement_preuve: Check: no card field in the app; payment messages are signed and verified.
gar.resiliation: My account → My subscription → “Stop the renewal”. Your rights last until the end of the paid period.
gar.donnees: No surname or email address for a child. Export and deletion of all your data from My account. Hosting planned in the European Union.
gar.donnees_preuve: Check: export and deletion tested; pseudonyms only.
gar.hors_ligne: A downloaded lesson works without network; your answers are sent when the network is back, with nothing lost or counted twice.

rac.intro: A three-consonant root + a pattern (ف ع ل) = a word. Roots, patterns and words come from your books — never made up.

rac.bravo: Yes! The consonants {racine} stay in the same order.

tj.indisponible: The tajwid colours for this surah are not on this device yet: connect to the Internet once to load them. The text is still shown, without colours.
tj.credit: Tajwid rules (riwāya Ḥafṣ): “quran-tajweed” annotations by Collin Fair, CC BY 4.0 licence, positions re-aligned by the app on the Tanzil text, no rule added. The Quran text is never changed: only colours are added.
tj.r_idgham: merging with nasal sound (الْإِدْغَامُ بِغُنَّةٍ), and for م labial merging (الْإِدْغَامُ الشَّفَوِيُّ)
tj.r_ikhfa: concealment (الْإِخْفَاءُ), and for م labial concealment (الْإِخْفَاءُ الشَّفَوِيُّ)
tj.r_madd246: lengthening when stopping (الْمَدُّ الْعَارِضُ لِلسُّكُونِ) or soft sound (مَدُّ اللِّينِ), 2, 4 or 6 counts
tj.r_assim: merging without nasal sound (الْإِدْغَامُ بِغَيْرِ غُنَّةٍ) or of two close letters: the merged letter is not pronounced
tj.r_muet: written but not pronounced: connecting hamza (هَمْزَةُ الْوَصْلِ) in continuous reading, sun ل (اللَّامُ الشَّمْسِيَّةُ), silent letter

qt.geo_refus: Location refused. Choose a city from the list instead.
qt.geo_indisponible: Location unavailable for now. Choose a city from the list.
qt.geo_delai: The location is taking too long. Try again, or choose a city.
qt.geo_absent: This device does not provide its location. Choose a city from the list.
qt.qibla_rose: Compass rose: the qibla is {n}° from north
qt.boussole_tourner: Turn until the diamond is at the top.
qt.rose_fixe: Without a compass: north is at the top. Find north (sun, map), then follow the angle.
qt.boussole_indisponible: No compass on this device: use the angle and the map.
qt.boussole_refus: Access to orientation refused: use the angle and the map.
qt.aimants: Metal objects, magnets, speakers and magnetic cases distort the compass. Move away from them, and check with the nearest mosque.
qt.carte_aide: Shortest route on the globe (great circle), north at the top. A simple diagram, without country borders.
qt.carte_aria: Schematic map of the shortest route to the Kaʿba
qt.adhkar_absents_texte: Connect to the Internet once: they will then be kept on the device.
qt.adhkar_copie: No network: copy kept on the device.
qt.versets_hors_ligne: The text of these verses will appear after connecting to the Internet.
qt.compteur_libre_aide: Tap the circle at each repetition. Nothing is saved.
qt.adhkar_origine: Texts, meanings and sources taken from the Awzid books (Islamic sciences), with nothing added; verses: Tanzil text. More supplications will be added after review by the religious referent.
qt.verset_intro: A simple, sober image of the verse, with its reference and the translation of its meaning, to send to your loved ones.
qt.avec_traduction: With the translation of the meaning
qt.verset_hors_ligne: This verse is not on the device yet: connect to the Internet once.
qt.verset_trop_long: Long verse: the text is reduced to the smallest readable size. Try without the translation.
qt.verset_regles: The verse text is that of the Muṣḥaf (Tanzil), reproduced unchanged; no image of people and no figurative decoration.
signal.sans_donnees: Do not write any personal data (name, address, phone…).
signal.r_ok: Thank you! The reviewer will check.
signal.r_attente: No network: the report will be sent when you are back online.
signal.r_deja_signale: You already reported this passage today.
signal.r_trop_de_signalements: Too many reports today: try again tomorrow.
signal.r_non_connecte: Sign in to report an error.
signal.r_erreur: The report could not be sent.
signal.suspendu_lecon: This lesson is temporarily unavailable while it is being checked.
signal.suspendu_bloc: A passage is temporarily withdrawn while it is being checked.
signal.corrige_change: The answer key of exercise {n} was corrected: do it again. Your other answers are kept.
contenu.aide: Errors reported by families and learners. Review, then mark as corrected (the erratum is public) or reject (reason required). Emergency suspension hides the passage everywhere.
errata.intro: Corrections made to the content after a report, checked by the reviewer.
sync.de_cote: {n, plural, one {# answer refused by the server is kept on this device.} other {# answers refused by the server are kept on this device.}}
sync.signale: Problem reported, thank you. The answers stay on the device.
sync.toujours_refusees: Still refused: they stay on the device.
erreur.transition_interdite: This status change is not possible.
erreur.bloc_introuvable: Passage not found in the published edition.
erreur.reserve_referent: Reserved for the reviewer and administrators.
etab.ecole_creee: School created: you are its head.
etab.classe_info: main teacher: {titulaire} · {n, plural, =0 {no learners} one {# learner} other {# learners}} · {statut}
etab.cloture_aide: One decision per learner. Promoted learners move to the next level; the year's marks, papers and lists stay in the archives.
etab.tablette_aide: Your session closes on this device: only the class's learners work on it. To leave, sign in again.
etab.code_parent: Code to give to {nom}'s parent (valid 60 days):
etab.consentement_papier: The consent form signed on paper stays at the school. Record its date, who signed it and its reference: this is the proof kept.
etab.profil_cree: Profile created for {nom}: the school is responsible for it.
fam.lien: Guardians, second parent, link a child
fam.rattacher: Link a child to my account
fam.rattacher_aide: Enter the code given by your child's school or by the other parent.
fam.rattache_titulaire: The profile is linked to your account: you now hold it. The school keeps following its class.
fam.rattache_parent: You are now responsible for this profile, together with the other parent.
fam.emancipation: Hand the profile over to my child
fam.second_aide: The other parent will enter the code in their own account and will see the profile as you do.
fam.emancipation_aide: Your child creates their own account and enters the code: they take over their profile with its full history, and you are no longer responsible for it.
fam.code_second: Code to give to the other parent:
fam.code_emancipation: Code to give to your child:
fam.reprendre_aide: Enter the code given by your parent: your profile, with your full history, moves to your account.
fam.reprise_ok: Your profile is now in your account, with your full history.
erreur.compte_inconnu: No usable account with this address: the person must first create an account.
erreur.derniere_direction: The school must keep at least one head.
erreur.pas_enseignant_de_l_ecole: This person does not teach in this school.
erreur.decisions_incompletes: Some learners are missing a decision.
erreur.annee_non_ouverte: This year is not the current one.
erreur.deja_profil: This learner already has a profile.
erreur.date_consentement_invalide: The form date cannot be in the future.
erreur.profil_non_gere_par_l_ecole: This profile is managed by its family.
erreur.compte_deja_utilise: This account already has an active profile: use a new account.
erreur.classe_sans_titulaire: The class has no main teacher for now.
parc.act_lectures: Read a booklet at my level
parc.coran_libre: Read and listen to the Quran
parc.commencer_texte: Start at the beginning of the first book, or take a short test made of exercises from the books: it places you at the right level.
parc.livre_papier: The printed book is recommended but not required: the app covers the whole path on its own.
parc.anciens_texte: The books you have finished, to review whenever you like.
parc.apercu_regle: Preview only: the lessons will open once you pass your level's test or when your teacher decides.
parc.epreuve_demain: Test not passed: you can take it again tomorrow. Review your lessons until then.
parc.pratique_revisions: The words from your lessons, reviewed at the right time
parc.acces_revision: Finished book: you can read it again to review.
parc.acces_apercu: Next level, preview: titles only. It opens when you pass your level's test.
parc.acces_ferme: This book is not open for you yet: move forward step by step in your level.
parc.cahier_texte: The writing for each lesson: in the exercise book, or on the printable sheet if you don't have it.
parc.cahier_vide: Writing will come with your first lesson.
parc.ecris_coran_ferme: “I write the Quran” opens at the lesson where your book has you copy your first verse.
parc.rasm_texte: The Quran is written with its own spelling, that of the Muṣḥaf (rasm ʿuthmānī): some words are not written as in everyday Arabic. Copy it exactly like the model, without “correcting” it.
parc.etapes_faites: {n, plural, =0 {no step done} one {# step done} other {# steps done}}
parc.etape3_condition: “From memory” opens when Quran reading booklet 1 is finished and about half of Juzʾ ʿAmma is memorised (today: {pct} %).
parc.consigne_1: Copy the verse into your exercise book, slowly: the letters, then the dots, the vowels and the signs.
parc.consigne_2: Listen to the reciter and write the verse as a dictation, without looking at the model.
parc.consigne_3: Write the verse from memory, without a model.
parc.comparer: Compare your writing with the model, word by word, and tick what is right.
parc.pas_de_note: No mark: you compare it yourself, with the model.
parc.etape_faite: Well done, step completed. You can start again whenever you like.
parc.fiche_dictee: An adult reads the lesson's dictation; I write on the lines.
parc.fiche_pied: Sheet taken from the student's book — to be done on paper.
parc.couverture: You recognise {pct} % of the words of the Quran
parc.couverture_detail: {n, plural, one {# word learnt} other {# words learnt}} (calculated on the text of the Quran)
parc.mots_niveau: Words of your book: {acquis} learnt out of {n}
parc.mots_source: Words, meanings and examples: as in your books.
parc.jeu_consigne: Choose the meaning of the word
parc.jeu_encore: Not quite: look at the right answer.
parc.jeu_gagnes: {n, plural, one {# new word learnt} other {# new words learnt}}
parc.positionnement_intro: A short test made of exercises from the books' end-of-level tests. We start at the first level; when it gets too hard, we stop: that is your level. Your teacher can change it.
parc.epreuve_intro: The exercises of your book's final test. Pass it to open the next level.
parc.positionnement_change: This is now your level: you will find its lessons in “My Arabic”.
parc.positionnement_garde: Your current level suits you: keep going.
parc.epreuve_conseil: You can take the test again tomorrow.
parc.maitre_corrige: Your teacher can always decide on another level.
parc.sans_classe: You are not enrolled in any class.

fam.reinscription_ok: Re-enrolment confirmed: the teacher can follow progress again.
fam.demander: I ask to manage my profile on my own
fam.demande_aide: From the age set by the country's law, young people can ask for autonomy; the parent approves it. At 18, it is a right.
erreur.niveau_hors_ordre: This level is not to be tested yet: restart the test from the beginning.
erreur.reessayer_plus_tard: You can take the test again tomorrow.
erreur.aucun_niveau: No level has been chosen yet.
erreur.dernier_niveau: This is the last book of this path.
erreur.decision_du_maitre: On the class tablet, the teacher decides the level.
cl.memo_hafs: While memorising, the text is that of Ḥafṣ (hifẓ notebooks).
cl.tous_recitateurs: All reciters, credits and saved surahs
cl.guidage: Guided reading word by word (no sound)
cl.guidage_aide: Words light up one after another over the chosen range, then a “your turn” pause to recite alone.
ca.en_ligne_aide: Online listening only (Quran Foundation): nothing is saved on the device.
erreur.connexion_requise: Sign in to listen to online reciters.
erreur.qf_indisponible: Online listening is not responding right now. Try again later or choose a reciter from the King Fahd Complex.
erreur.qf_incomplet: This surah is not available online for this reciter.
erreur.en_ligne_seulement: This reciter is online only: it cannot be saved on the device.
gar.audio_en_ligne: “Online” reciters (al-Ḥuṣarī, al-ʿAfāsī…): audio provided by Quran Foundation (quran.foundation), online only — nothing is downloaded, stored or resold; the other recitations come from the King Fahd Complex (Madinah).
